verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides managed auth that keeps raw credentials away from the agent: requests go through Pipedream's servers and are never exposed to models. Access can be scoped to a single end user via `x-pd-external-user-id` and to a single app's dedicated MCP server via `x-pd-app-slug`, and users can revoke connected accounts at any time. However, nothing shows issuing agent-specific credentials with restricted OAuth scopes, permissions or tool subsets. missing for 10: explicit per-agent scoped token issuance, configurable OAuth scopes or permissions (e.g. read-only), tool-level allowlisting, independent corroboration.
